answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 8445 Country: India Title: I am 30 year old woman ... i always fall ill when i wear yellow coloured clothes..whether in islam wearing a partcular colour affect ones health and personality? Please advise... shukran Question: I am 30 year old woman ... i always fall ill when i wear yellow coloured clothes..whether in islam wearing a partcular colour affect ones health and personality? Please advise... shukran Answer ID: 8445 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1299/1113=L/1429) As per the Shariah, there is no such effect in a cloth that one falls ill, rather it is prohibited in Hadith. However, if you fall ill by wearing yellow-colour clothes then it is advisable for you to forsake wearing the colour so that no adverse effect may creep in your belief and faith. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
